title: nealab: A Reproducible Platform for Subnational Geospatial Analysis
description: Reproducible platform combining satellite imagery, census data, and geospatial datasets into composite indicators over an H3 hexagonal grid. Applied to the NEA (northeast Argentina) and its cross-border regions (Paraguay and southern Brazil), with ~320,000 hexagons per territory across four analytical domains.
